triage.fix_rationale: Updating the lockfile (npm audit fix) bumps the vulnerable transitive packages to patched versions. package.json needs a change only for direct dependencies such as @angular/router, or if overrides are needed for the @angular/cli and @angular/build chains.
triage.hypothesis: npm audit at --audit-level=high found 17 vulnerabilities (3 critical, 9 high) in the npm dependency tree, including @angular/router, piscina, proxy-addr, undici and brace-expansion. The Dependabot PR's lockfile still resolves vulnerable versions; each advisory says a fix is available via npm audit fix.
